name: Saturday hike
description: Three trails with maps and photos. Vote, compare, then the agent plans the day.

capabilities.purpose: Show how far each trailhead is from you. Your location stays on this phone.
Add the hike you picked to your calendar. You see the event before it's saved.
Add the photos you choose to the group's hike album.

networkPurpose: Load map tiles (OpenFreeMap, no account, no tracking). Without it you get a simple offline map.
